svg.title: Express and Studio, engine by engine
svg.desc: Two swimlane charts, one row per engine and one column per step. Express: Claude Code runs setup, the Brief and the script, research and planner and builder subagents follow, VoiceStudio or Kokoro speaks the voice (ElevenLabs only on request), the scenes are Canvas 2D isometric (three.js only for object-studio), HyperFrames lints and renders, scripts check every gate and no reviewer is used. Studio: the same start, then Blender models the subject once in the Look step, three.js renders the still, style frames and scenes, HyperFrames snapshots, composes and renders a draft and a high final, a reviewer scores the style frames at Gate 3 and reviews the draft with a quiz at Gate 4. A playhead sweeps each chart and fills each bar while that engine works.
svg.text: fast lane · about 20 minutes · no stop after the Brief
reuses a library model; never models
none: the scripts pass every gate
precision lane · the subject modelled once from your pictures
G1–G4: the four gates. *Ref: optional, a reference video measured. ElevenLabs (paid) replaces the voice only on request.
